name: Dumbbell Reverse Wrist Curl
steps: Kneel beside a bench with your forearms on the pad and your hands beyond the edge, palms down around the dumbbells.
Lift the backs of your hands by extending your wrists.
Lower the dumbbells slowly through a comfortable range.
tips: Keep your forearms pressed flat to the bench.
Use a controlled range without jerking your elbows or shoulders upward.
